elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Customer (preferred)
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products" — a restraint on the Company (Customer) remains

elements.element: Exclusivity confined to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" — "Deerskin Products" is a defined term in Section 1.1
"during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date" (replacing "during the term of this Agreement")

elements.element: Automatic termination of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically and without penalty ... upon HDI's failure to meet any service level, availability ... obligation"

elements.element: Automatic termination of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates
elements.evidence: "or delivery date obligation under this Agreement, including Section 1.6"

reasons: Fallback is fully satisfied on its material terms: the restraint is now confined to the defined "Deerskin Products" category, capped at twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, and falls away automatically on HDI's failure to meet a service level or delivery date obligation.
Preferred is not met — an exclusivity obligation binding the Company (our client) survives, so the clause sits at the fallback rather than the preferred no-exclusivity position.

Minimality fails: operation 2 expands a 13-word anchor into a 55-word proviso (official gate: ratio 4.23 > 1.50; changed-character ratio 0.795 > 0.600). A tighter insertion such as "; provided, that this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date obligation." would complete the fallback.

"without penalty or Termination Payment" adds protection beyond the fallback and cuts across the separate Section 4.1(a) Termination Payment mechanic, which attaches to termination of the Agreement rather than lapse of Section 6.1; "availability" and "including Section 1.6" are likewise surplus to the required trigger.
Intent is preserved: HDI's exclusive brand right and the surrounding term/termination and Section 6.2 carve-out remain effective and no undefined term is introduced.
